notes: One route, not two: «قال: أخبرني محمد بن جعفر» is the same speaker (الحسين بن محمد النوفلي) continuing his chain, so the routes read in the archive's second part belong to one isnad.
«من ولد نوفل بن عبد المطلب» identifies the Nawfali and is left out of the surface.
The question («في المرض يصيب الصبي؟») has no named asker, so no asker link is added. Ali, written after «عن», is a narrator; his answer («كفارة لوالديه») is the saying.
